# Bundled UI components

Files are local, pinned, unmodified distributions except omitted final newline handling; no runtime CDN.

| Component | Version | Source | License file |
|---|---|---|---|
| Split.js | 1.6.5 | https://unpkg.com/split.js@1.6.5/dist/split.min.js | SPLIT-LICENSE.txt (MIT) |
| Panzoom | 4.6.0 | https://unpkg.com/@panzoom/panzoom@4.6.0/dist/panzoom.min.js | PANZOOM-LICENSE.txt (MIT) |
| Lucide SVG icons | 0.468.0 | https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/0.468.0/icons | LUCIDE-LICENSE.txt (ISC) |

Split upstream: https://github.com/nathancahill/split. Panzoom upstream: https://github.com/timmywil/panzoom. Lucide upstream: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide.
icons.js only wraps folder-open, clapperboard, scissors and layout-grid SVGs in a local object.
